disposition: No substantiated in-scope defects found; bounded review, not general geometry or release qualification.

highValueChecks.trigger: Hash all manifest entries before and after work.
highValueChecks.expected: All source bytes match the supplied manifest.
highValueChecks.observed: 652/652 match at both boundaries; no source or main edits.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: File identity only, not independent root build provenance.

highValueChecks.trigger: Recompute SHA; repeat prepare; change filename/materialSource/workLimit and confirmation fields; mutate borrowed original/candidate/correspondence buffers then restore.
highValueChecks.expected: Identical context yields identical hashes; altered context fails or yields new hashes; no pre-confirmation file.
highValueChecks.observed: Independent source and complete AFCP hashes match. Changed settings bind distinct proposal hashes. Original-buffer changes reject STALE_CONTEXT; candidate/correspondence changes reject BUFFER_CHANGED. Prepare publishes no final-output file.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Serial ABI contract. Descriptor equality does not supply UI consent or application CAS.

highValueChecks.trigger: Read back/prepare assembly clicky; forge matching caller revision/expectedRevision 99; submit copied client reader.
highValueChecks.expected: Root immutable Payload restrictions remain mandatory.
highValueChecks.observed: ASSEMBLY_VIEW, STALE_REVISION and SNAPSHOT_LEASE_OWNERSHIP rejections. Readback repeats Pin::new before publication; confirm pins and rehashes retained source. Readback returns a final-output lease rather than publishing a root snapshot. No bypass found.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Actual clicky/assembly fixtures exercised; current application context after export and account/project CAS are outside scope.

highValueChecks.trigger: Grow real WASM memory; edit defensive views; retain files through source/proposal release; retire/restart worker; mix output handle kinds.
highValueChecks.expected: Owned copies/leases survive expected lifetimes; stale/forged/cross-kind handles fail; retired release does not start a Worker.
highValueChecks.observed: All checked native, Node and three production-browser cases satisfy these requirements. Worker routes use one injected root Module; test processes intentionally use separate copies.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Registry statistics corroborate these runs, not arbitrary raw-pointer safety or allocator/RSS bounds.

highValueChecks.trigger: Malformed registered wire, displacement/work limits, proposal/output caps, pre-cancel, native mid-proof observer and Worker confirm cancellation.
highValueChecks.expected: Inputs consumed, typed failures, no canceled publication, existing leases retained.
highValueChecks.observed: 43 supplied native assertions passed, including cancellation during proof at progress >=870. Mixed ordinary/readback output cap and Worker cancellation passed; observed root counters return to zero.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Working memory is an admission model. Work units do not bound all native CSG CPU time, worst-case RSS or wall-clock time.

highValueChecks.trigger: Export analytic union before/after readback, failures and output-cap pressure; ordinary export default clicky.
highValueChecks.expected: Successful ordinary bytes stay identical; legacy collision rejection remains.
highValueChecks.observed: Analytic 1500 mm3 union STL and complete metadata remain identical. Default clicky remains INVALID_SERIALIZATION:STL_FLOAT_COLLISION natively, mapped to INVALID_SERIALIZATION at Worker API.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Union STL success/failure checked, not every legacy material ZIP/SVG option.

highValueChecks.trigger: 16 tuple/order combinations, boundary materialSource values and slot 65535; edit returned bytes and repeat.
highValueChecks.expected: Union iff full (slot,RGBA,materialSource) agrees; preserve memberships/interiors; no f32 conversion or pass verdict.
highValueChecks.observed: Correct grouping and memberships in all cases. Exact integer determinants give 1500 mm3 merged volume or two 1000 mm3 groups with analytic 500 mm3 overlap. Source unchanged; owned copies stable. Production material ARCH retains non-f32 coordinates and equals native bytes.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: CSG and overlap warnings are not an independent mesh checker or proof of equivalence to future exporter settings.

highValueChecks.trigger: 24,000 deterministic pairs: spatial/coplanar, zero/one/two shared vertices, winding permutations and bounded large integer transforms.
highValueChecks.expected: Match independent exact rational polygon clipping and segment-plane oracle excluding allowed shared simplex.
highValueChecks.observed: Zero mismatches; six categories of 4000, seed 20260908.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Finite differential corpus, not exhaustive i128 proof. Standalone harness compiles unchanged captured math with cancellation stubbed; no native CSG.

highValueChecks.trigger: 14 synthetic cases: inverse subdivisions, ties/above-tie, aliases, three-point clusters, tetrahedron counterexample, separated/nested/interpenetrating/AABB-overlap components, nonedge collision, exponent span, embedded torus.
highValueChecks.expected: Supported contractions preserve topology; unsupported/intersecting surfaces fail typed.
highValueChecks.observed: 14/14 expected outcomes. Embedded torus accepted at Euler 0 with 64 vertices/128 faces. Nested/overlapping AABBs reject COMPONENT_RELATION_UNPROVEN; intersecting components reject SELF_INTERSECTION.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Abstract source topology and final embedding are checked, not original-source embedding or the swept deformation.

highValueChecks.trigger: Exhaust default source/retained/removed face correspondence and STL corners; exact rational squared-distance check on accepted synthetic cases.
highValueChecks.expected: Affine face correspondence and removed-image coverage support the outward vertex bound over the entire surface.
highValueChecks.observed: Default 2648 vertices/5288 faces -> 2424/4840 after 224 contractions and 448 removed faces; measured 3.9185716493157654e-6 mm <= upper bound 3.918571649315768e-6 mm. Accepted synthetic cases also satisfy exact rational bounds.
highValueChecks.uncertainty: Local bidirectional Hausdorff bound to captured native union only; no upstream SVG/grid/boolean, volume-error, ambient-isotopy, fit or slicer guarantee.

limitations: Supplied source-pinned native and production/instrumented WASM binaries used; no independent root rebuild. Only the pure-math reviewer harness was independently compiled.
Finite tests and code reasoning do not prove general geometry correctness. Original-source embedding/qualification are separate prerequisites.
Local bound is relative to captured native post-CSG/pose union; upstream SVG/grid/boolean error, volume error, ambient isotopy, physical fit and slicers remain unqualified.
Only paired collision edges and bounded exponent/work/component relationships supported; nested or overlapping component AABBs fail closed.
UI consent/current application CAS, backend/accounts, all legacy ZIP/SVG settings, all source/product families and real printers are outside scope.
executionNotes: Order preserved: native prerequisite -> file/correspondence oracle -> production Worker parity.
Browser harness only adapts snapshot routing, read-only dependency resolution and profiles under work/cache.

Reviewer harness setup errors were corrected inside the room: incomplete vendor checksum route replaced with private Cargo cache/index; missing Vec type annotations fixed; floating accumulated-volume assertion replaced with exact integer determinant verification. These are not product findings.
Helper shell commands blocked before execution were retried with safe file operations in the room; no escalation or unresolved approval block.
